questions.prompt: Before the general could give the signal, the enemy attacked the camp.
questions.answer: Antequam dux signum daret, hostēs castra oppugnāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The tempest threatens before it rises over the mountains.
questions.answer: Tempestās minātur antequam super montēs surgat.

questions.prompt: They preferred to meet death rather than yield their post.
questions.answer: Mortem oppetere māluērunt priusquam statiōne cēderent.

questions.prompt: The sun, before it set, saw Antony fleeing across the plain.
questions.answer: Sōl, antequam sē abderet, fugientem trāns campum Antōnium vīdit.

questions.prompt: Before the treaty was struck, the two kings prepared for war.
questions.answer: Priusquam foedus īcerētur, ambō rēgēs bellum parāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The fishermen reached the harbor before the storm could sink the ship.
questions.answer: Piscātōrēs portum attigērunt antequam procella nāvem mergere posset.

questions.prompt: Before a single word could be spoken, the crowd broke into an uproar.
questions.answer: Priusquam ūllum verbum dīcī posset, turba in murmur ērūpit.

questions.prompt: The old man died before he could taste the bitter wine.
questions.answer: Senex mortuus est antequam acerbum vīnum gustāret.

questions.prompt: Before the soldiers scaled the wall, the defenders hurled stones.
questions.answer: Antequam mīlitēs mūrum ascenderent, dēfēnsōrēs saxa iēcērunt.

questions.prompt: The poet finished the song before dawn could rise from the sea.
questions.answer: Poēta carmen cōnfēcit antequam aurōra ē marī surgeret.

questions.prompt: They fled the tavern before the quarrel could grow more fierce.
questions.answer: Ex popīnā fūgērunt priusquam iūrgium ācrius fieret.

questions.prompt: Before the messenger could return, the citizens had already seized the gates.
questions.answer: Priusquam nūntius redīret, cīvēs iam portās rapuerant.

questions.prompt: The maiden hid the lyre before her angry father could find it.
questions.answer: Virgō lyram abdidit antequam īrātus pater eam invenīret.

questions.prompt: Before the fire could warm the house, the guests had departed.
questions.answer: Priusquam ignis domum calefaceret, hospitēs discesserant.

questions.prompt: The general withdrew his troops before the enemy could surround them.
questions.answer: Dux cōpiās redūxit antequam hostēs eās circumdarent.

questions.prompt: They preferred to bear shame rather than betray their friends.
questions.answer: Pudōrem perferre māluērunt priusquam amīcōs prōderent.

questions.prompt: Before the swift horseman could cross the marshy field, night fell.
questions.answer: Antequam celer eques palūstrem campum trānsīret, nox cecidit.

questions.prompt: The thirsty travelers drank deeply before the spring could dry up.
questions.answer: Sitientēs viātōrēs largē combibērunt priusquam fōns exārēsceret.

questions.prompt: Before winter could arrive, the farmers gathered the whole harvest.
questions.answer: Antequam hiems venīret, agricolae tōtam messem collēgērunt.

questions.prompt: The queen fled the city before the flames could reach the palace.
questions.answer: Rēgīna urbe fūgit priusquam flammae rēgiam attingerent.

questions.prompt: Before the judge could pronounce sentence, the accused confessed everything.
questions.answer: Priusquam iūdex sententiam prōnūntiāret, reus omnia cōnfessus est.

questions.prompt: The boy hurried home before the rain could soak his clothes.
questions.answer: Puer domum festīnāvit antequam pluvia vestēs madefaceret.

questions.prompt: Before the guests could recline at the table, the slave had prepared the couches.
questions.answer: Antequam convīvae ad mēnsam accumberent, servus lectōs parāverat.

questions.prompt: The wounded soldier spoke before his strength could utterly fail.
questions.answer: Vulnerātus mīles locūtus est priusquam vīrēs omnīnō dēficerent.
